verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only Figma-hosted publishing with a custom domain and in-app code viewing and editing. There is no documented code export, download, or deploy path to an external host or the user's own infrastructure. Community reports describe reverse-engineering the undocumented .make binary to extract the React apps, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy the generated app to an external host or my own infrastructure
